WITH sentiment_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    t.transreg,
    t.ordertypedist,
    s.instownpct
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
),
units AS (
  SELECT 
    transreg,
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(instownpct) as ownership
  FROM sentiment_trans
  WHERE ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist
),
with_mix_baseline AS (
  SELECT 
    u.*,
    AVG(u.ownership) OVER (PARTITION BY u.ordertypedist) as mix_baseline
  FROM units u
),
with_overall_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    w.*,
    AVG(w.ownership) OVER () as overall_avg
  FROM with_mix_baseline w
),
kept_units AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM with_overall_avg
  WHERE ownership > overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ownership) as avg_ownership_kept,
  AVG(ownership / mix_baseline) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(ownership - overall_avg) as avg_excess
FROM kept_units
